response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt::double precision / (SUM(cnt) OVER ())::double precision AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares) SELECT s.tradekind, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS share_minus_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s;

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins drop behaviour records whose translink has no matching transactionrecord or whose transaction's trdref has no matching trader, as the request specifies.
Only NULL tradekind counts as the missing type; GROUP BY places all NULLs in one group. Blank strings would be a separate type.
The average is the unweighted mean of the per-type shares. If no groups survive the joins, the average is NULL and the comparison returns no rows.
Shares and differences are computed as double precision with no ROUND. Floating-point representation still applies.
